sun.1: You lead with yourself. Your body, your bearing and how you walk into a room are what people meet first, and much of your life is set in motion by what you do first-hand.
sun.2: What you earn and own is part of how you know yourself. You tend to measure yourself by what you have built, and to feel steadier with something solid under you.
sun.3: Your sense of who you are gets worked out in conversation: siblings, neighbours, errands, messages and the small exchanges of the street you live on.
sun.4: Home, family and the ground under your feet hold much of your sense of self, often more than any public role. A parent, a house or a piece of land can matter enormously, and so can what you'll be standing on at the end.
sun.5: Pleasure, play, romance and making things are where you most feel like yourself and most want to be seen, whether what you make is children, art, or anything done for the love of it.
sun.6: Your life tends to find its shape in what gets done each day, quietly and in order: the small labours, the care of your health, and being useful to others.
sun.7: Partners, spouses and close collaborators hold your attention, and so do the people who oppose you openly. You tend to learn who you are by what happens across the table, contracts and agreements included.
sun.8: Shared money, debts, inheritance and what you owe draw your attention, and so, traditionally, does mortality. You are drawn to what is held in common and what must eventually be settled.
sun.9: A large idea or a distant horizon tends to organise your life. Long journeys, foreign places, belief and higher learning hold you, and you are often most yourself studying, teaching or travelling.
sun.10: Your work is visible, and you feel it. Career, reputation and the responsibility that comes with standing hold your attention, and others tend to know you through what you do.
sun.11: You find purpose through friends, allies and the people who back you, and you keep long-range hopes in view, often ones you share.
sun.12: Much of you happens out of sight: solitude, retreat, old sorrows, the habits that work against you. You may be clearest alone, and do your best work behind the scenes.

moon.1: Your moods show on the surface, and people read you through your temperament. You tend to notice how you feel in your body, how you respond, and how others see you react.
moon.2: Your sense of having enough shifts with the month. Money and possessions tend to be where you look for security, and what you own is tied to how settled you feel.
moon.3: Daily chatter, messages, siblings and the nearby streets steady you. This is where the Moon traditionally rests easily, and small, frequent exchange can feel like home.
moon.4: Home, family and the mother or other parent hold your moods closely. Roots and old houses carry real weight, and you may feel most like yourself, for better or worse, in your own rooms.
moon.5: Affection and play feed you. Pleasure, romance, children and making things tend to hold your attention, and a shared feeling or a creative project can steady you more than you expect.
moon.6: Your mood follows your habits. Daily routine, health and small tasks tend to draw you, and you care for others through practical service and notice bodily changes early.
moon.7: You feel through other people. A partner, an associate, even an opponent tells you how things stand, and your mood can follow the bond you're in.
moon.8: Shared money, debts, inheritance and what is owed tend to draw your attention. Traditionally, loss and endings sit here too, and you feel what passes between people and can be slow to let go of what was given.
moon.9: A wide horizon settles you. Travel, belief, study and far-off places can feel more like home than home does.
moon.10: Your public standing tends to rise and fall with how people feel about you. Work that serves the public or deals with ordinary people suits the pattern, and reputation is something you feel closely.
moon.11: Friends and groups steady you, and your hopes shift with who you spend time with. You gather people easily, and comfort often comes from the wider circle.
moon.12: You feel a great deal that you do not show. Solitude, dreams and private sorrow draw you, and you may need time apart to settle.

mercury.1: Quickness shows first. You tend to think, speak and notice at speed, and people often meet your voice, your wit or your hands before anything else. Mercury is traditionally at ease here.
mercury.2: You count carefully. Accounts, prices, trade and the skills you can sell occupy your thinking, and money often comes through talking, writing or dealing.
mercury.3: Your days fill with letters, errands, questions and local news. Writing, talk, siblings, neighbours and short journeys tend to hold your attention, with plenty of small exchanges each day.
mercury.4: Your thinking circles home, family and the past. Papers, records, family stories and talk with a parent tend to matter, and you may do your best reading and writing at home.
mercury.5: Wit, games and flirtation turn your mind to play. You enjoy clever company, write or make things for pleasure, and talk easily with children.
mercury.6: Lists, paperwork and daily detail hold your attention. You tend to solve practical problems well and to watch your health through careful observation.
mercury.7: You think through conversation. Partners, clients, negotiations and contracts tend to draw you, and you deal with open rivals by arguing the case.
mercury.8: You ask the questions others avoid. Your thinking goes to shared money, debts, wills and what is owed, and to whatever lies beneath accounts: secrets and endings.
mercury.9: Your mind likes to range. Study, travel, foreign languages and big questions tend to hold you, and you turn what you learn abroad into writing or teaching.
mercury.10: What you say or write gets noticed. Your thinking tends to attach to career and reputation, and work where talk, information or skill with words is visible suits you.
mercury.11: You gather ideas through other people. Friends, associates and networks tend to hold your attention, and you plan with allies and write to patrons.
mercury.12: Your mind turns inward, toward what is private: hidden knowledge, worry, solitary study and what goes unsaid. You tend to think best alone, and to mull things over at night.

venus.1: People often meet you first as warm and easy to be around. How you look and are received tends to matter to you, and grace, charm and comfort in your own body mark the position.
venus.2: Beauty and comfort matter in what you own. You earn or save through pleasing others or tasteful work, and money and possessions are where your taste shows.
venus.3: Daily exchange stays courteous. You are gentle in talk with siblings and neighbours, enjoy short trips, and feel affection for local places and the people living close by.
venus.4: You make a house pleasant. You wish for harmony with a parent and for comfort in later life, and your surroundings matter to you.
venus.5: Delight is the point here, and Venus is traditionally most at ease. Pleasure, romance, art and children tend to draw your attention, and you enjoy, give enjoyment and make things for the pleasure of it.
venus.6: Small comforts matter to your health. Venus brings a taste for pleasantness to the job: tidy workplaces, colleagues you like, and care given freely.
venus.7: You look for agreement. Partners and marriage tend to hold your attention, you treat open rivals with courtesy, and you value a bond that is fair to both sides.
venus.8: What other people give, and what you give back, is bound up with closeness. Gifts, shared money, inheritance and the intimacy of trust all carry feeling for you.
venus.9: Beauty far from home draws you. Long journeys, foreign cultures, belief and learning tend to hold your affection, along with teachers, faiths or places that feel generous.
venus.10: Charm and taste carry your standing. Your work tends to gain favour, and recognition may come in fields of beauty, hospitality or diplomacy.
venus.11: Good fortune tends to arrive through warm company. Friends, allies and patrons hold your attention, with affection for groups and hopes shared with people you like.
venus.12: Your tenderness is private. Quiet love and attachments kept out of sight tend to hold you, you find comfort in retreat, and you give more than you let anyone see.

mars.1: You act first. The body and being direct tend to hold your attention, and others often meet you as forceful before they meet anything else.
mars.2: You work hard for what you have. Your effort goes into money and possessions, you spend quickly, and you defend your resources when they are threatened.
mars.3: Your speech is blunt and quick. Talk, siblings, neighbours and short trips tend to stir you, and you bring energy to errands and local matters, arguments included.
mars.4: Your energy goes into home, family and land, sometimes through friction with a parent or over property. You're the one who works on the house, and who ends things firmly when they need ending.
mars.5: You pursue pleasure with heat. Sport, romance and making things tend to hold your attention, and you are competitive in play, ardent in love and energetic with children.
mars.6: Work is where your energy settles, and Mars is traditionally at home here. You tend to be hardworking and practical, good with tools and demanding tasks, and prone to overwork or minor injury.
mars.7: Partners and open rivals bring out your force. You meet people head on and argue over terms, and you may not mind friction in a bond. The work is telling friction from closeness.
mars.8: Shared money, debts, inheritance and what is owed can bring conflict. You deal directly with danger, loss and the settling of accounts.
mars.9: You argue for your convictions. Long journeys, belief and higher learning tend to draw your drive, and you can be restless abroad and treat study as a contest.
mars.10: Your ambition is visible. You aim at career and public standing, take command, and may meet opposition from those above.
mars.11: You work with groups toward a goal. Friends, allies and patrons are who you do it with, you fight for causes, and you sometimes quarrel with allies.
mars.12: Your effort goes unseen. Anger kept private, struggles out of sight and hidden opposition tend to hold you, and you work best in seclusion, with a safe outlet for drive.

jupiter.1: You come across as open, hopeful and large in presence. Growth and generosity tend to show in how you carry yourself, and others notice your appetite for life.
jupiter.2: Money tends to come with a leaning toward abundance. You earn by being generous or wise, and you tend to feel that enough can be found.
jupiter.3: You are generous in conversation. You like teaching, sharing news and being friendly to those nearby, and siblings, neighbours and short trips come easily.
jupiter.4: A roomy house suits you. Home, family and land tend to draw your attention, with generosity around the hearth, a settled later life, and people gathered around you.
jupiter.5: Your taste for enjoyment is expansive. Pleasure, romance, creative work and children tend to draw you, and play and the company of children come easily.
jupiter.6: You are helpful and well regarded among colleagues. Daily work, health and service are where you give, and you may take on more than a single day allows.
jupiter.7: You look for fairness in partners and agreements. You may gain through marriage or alliance, and you meet open rivals with a large view.
jupiter.8: You trust what others hold in common. Shared resources, inheritance and debts are where you may receive, and traditionally, endings are faced with some breadth here.
jupiter.9: Jupiter has room to roam here. Long journeys, foreign places, belief and learning tend to hold you, and you may be a teacher or traveller drawn to large ideas.
jupiter.10: Generosity builds your reputation. Your career and public standing carry honour, and people look to you for judgment.
jupiter.11: Good company supports you, and Jupiter is traditionally most at ease here. Friends, allies and patrons tend to hold your attention, along with hopes shared with many people.
jupiter.12: Your generosity is private. Retreat, charity and faith in hard times matter to you, with help from unseen sources and meaning in solitude or in service to people who are confined.

saturn.1: You hold yourself with restraint. Self-discipline tends to hold your attention, and others see you as reserved, serious or slow to warm, steady and sometimes guarded.
saturn.2: Money comes slowly and stays. You tend to earn steadily, save, and trust what has been proven, and your security rests on what you have built.
saturn.3: You speak little and carefully. Siblings, neighbours and short trips get measured attention from you, with duties toward a sibling or a certain distance from those nearby.
saturn.4: Family duty has weight. You build slowly on land or property, and a parent matters to you. Traditionally, this house speaks of the close of the matter, which you meet with seriousness.
saturn.5: You take enjoyment seriously. You come to pleasure, romance, children and creative play with caution, and once you commit in love and parenthood you stay committed.
saturn.6: You are dependable at daily labour. Work and routine get your steady effort, you are thorough with detail, and you watch your health with discipline and some worry.
saturn.7: You take commitments seriously. Partners, marriage and contracts tend to hold you, you are wary at first, and open rivals may test your patience.
saturn.8: You are careful about obligations. Shared money, debts and inheritance weigh on you, and traditionally, mortality is faced here with sobriety.
saturn.9: You are exacting about doctrine. Long journeys, belief and higher learning tend to draw you, and you take your time to commit to a view and treat travel and study seriously.
saturn.10: Reputation is built slowly, through work and responsibility. You give career and public standing sustained attention, and a visible position carries real weight.
saturn.11: You keep few friends and keep them long. Friends, allies and hopes tend to draw cautious attention, you pursue aims patiently, and groups earn your trust over time.
saturn.12: Solitude is where you carry what is private. Saturn is traditionally at home here, which suits long, quiet work and a capacity for being alone, with old fears to face.

uranus.1: You don't quite fit the expected shape, and people notice. Your manner or look is unusual, and the way you present yourself can change suddenly.
uranus.2: Money keeps its own timetable. Income may arrive or vanish in surprising ways, and independence tends to matter more to you than stability.
uranus.3: Your thinking takes sudden turns. You speak unconventionally, and siblings, neighbours and local ties bring the unexpected.
uranus.4: Home rarely stays one shape. Your roots may be unconventional, you may move often, or you may be the one who breaks the family pattern.
uranus.5: Love and art take unusual shapes for you. You are drawn to the unexpected in romance and creative work, and dealings with children can surprise you.
uranus.6: Your daily habits keep getting redesigned. You tend toward restlessness in set tasks, invent your own methods, and disrupt and rebuild routine.
uranus.7: You need freedom inside closeness. People arrive in your life suddenly, and partings can be just as abrupt.
uranus.8: Joint affairs change suddenly. Shared money, debts and inheritance tend to turn up surprises, and you are drawn to the odd corners of what is owed.
uranus.9: You question accepted views. Belief, travel and learning draw original attention, with a pull toward foreign or unorthodox ideas and abrupt changes of mind.
uranus.10: Your path turns suddenly. Career and public standing draw attention through change, and you are visible for being unconventional or breaking from the expected.
uranus.11: You value friendship that leaves room for difference. Groups of unusual people tend to draw you, and allies may appear or leave abruptly.
uranus.12: Insight arrives in private flashes. Hidden things tend to draw sudden attention, you think freshly in solitude, and there is a quiet streak of rebellion.

neptune.1: You can seem different to different people, and sometimes to yourself. Your sense of self is soft and impressionable, and hard for others to pin down.
neptune.2: Money can be hazy. You may be generous or unclear about what you have, and it helps to check figures others take for granted.
neptune.3: Your speech is coloured by imagination. You tend to speak in images and pick up moods nearby, and sometimes misread or are misread.
neptune.4: Home carries a dreamlike weight. Your roots may be idealised or hard to define, with a parent or house that slips out of focus.
neptune.5: You fall for pictures: of people, of art, of what love could be. Imagination runs strong in romance and creative work, and so does the risk of loving the image more than the person.
neptune.6: You respond to the atmosphere of a workplace. Work and routine draw a sensitive attention, and clear habits help keep health and tasks steady.
neptune.7: You want a bond that feels meant. That longing can be beautiful, and it's also why it pays to read contracts closely and to check what others say about themselves.
neptune.8: What passes unspoken between people reaches you. Shared money and what is owed tend to be unclear, so plain records of debts and inheritance help.
neptune.9: You trust a vision readily. Belief, faraway places and learning draw imaginative attention, with a pull toward the spiritual or the distant, sometimes ahead of proof.
neptune.10: Public standing tends to blur. Your reputation is hard to fix, your career may lie in imaginative or caring fields, and direction can stay uncertain for a while.
neptune.11: You give to groups and causes, and your hopes carry an idealising colour. It can be hard to judge whom to trust.
neptune.12: The unseen is a quiet home for you: dreams, retreat, compassion for people who suffer out of sight. It can also be where you go to escape, so it helps to know which one you're doing.

pluto.1: People sense you strongly before you've said much. You guard what lies underneath, and you may go through deep personal change more than once.
pluto.2: Security gets rebuilt more than once. Money and possessions tend to draw intense attention, and you think hard about power and what you truly hold.
pluto.3: Your words carry weight. You speak penetratingly, notice what is concealed in conversation, and may have charged ties to siblings or neighbours.
pluto.4: Home holds deep, buried material. Your roots may involve upheaval or strong inheritance, and later years can bring a clearing of old ground.
pluto.5: You love all or nothing, in romance and in art, and feelings around children can run deep.
pluto.6: You rebuild systems at work. Daily routine draws thorough, almost obsessive attention, and compulsion and strain are worth watching in your health.
pluto.7: Close bonds bring powerful people. Partners draw strong attention, and contracts and rivalries can change you.
pluto.8: You look straight at endings, power and what is owed. Shared money, debts and inheritance draw deep attention, and Pluto fits this house's old themes closely, including, traditionally, mortality.
pluto.9: You pursue convictions to their roots. Belief, travel and learning draw intense attention, and encounters with foreign or ruling ideas can change you.
pluto.10: Your public role involves authority, upheaval and renewal. Career draws attention to power, and you may rise and fall more than once.
pluto.11: Friendships change you. You may be drawn to influential groups, and some alliances end hard, which can show you who your real people are.
pluto.12: What's buried runs deepest here. Long solitude and private reckonings change you slowly, often unseen by anyone else.
